note: Which parts of Ostrel Rhea can reach. The map is closed except for the places that matter right now: story places for the current stage, places where a recruit can be found, and rare finds that are there to be found at that point. Each open place opens the ground within 'reach' tiles of it, and the road from Larkfold to it. 'from' and 'until' are stages (in 'order'), 'when' is a story condition. A region can still be opened whole with the flag open.<region>. 'why' is what Rhea is told at the edge of the open ground.

larkfold.note: Home. Always reachable; the harvest brings Rhea back in a7.

thornwick.note: On the road down to Ferrow. The future base: seen in passing in Act I.

camp.note: The Commons camp. Ferris is treed by his reedcat here.

millbridge.note: On the road to Hob's Bend; won over in a5. Oren joins here.

sallow.note: Kane's attack on the hatchery. Ruins afterwards.

finds.text: Duskwort, growing wild on the old monastery terraces. Healers dry a sprig to keep their hands steady.
A drove bell, lost in the grass above the camp. Kith settle to the sound of it.
A brass indenture number, thrown from the cart. Nobody was ever stamped with it.
A tray-iron from the burnt brood house, cooled in the ditch. Heavy enough to forge into something.

why.guild: Guild checkpoints ring Vantry. Without indenture papers, Rhea would be taken at the first one.
why.crown: Crown foresters patrol the royal parks. Anyone without a pass is turned back, or worse.
why.corvane: League toll-men hold the hill roads. Nobody without a Corvane letter gets past the toll houses.
why.hollin: The Free Towns have shut their gates to strangers from the north since the raids.
why.college: The College lets in patients and physicians. Rhea is neither, yet.
why.drevka: Drevka clan riders watch the high grazing. Strangers who come uninvited don't come back down.
why.ember: Between here and the Ember Courts is a week of desert. Nobody crosses it without water, a guide and a reason.
why.tarsis: Tarsis sells swords to whoever pays. Walking up to their walls unannounced is how you get sold too.
why.ashby: The coast road to Port Ashby is watched by smugglers who don't like new faces.
why.lorne: The road north to Lorne is closed until the snow lifts from the passes.
why.high-passes: Snow chokes the passes. Nobody gets through until the thaw.
why.cloud-forest: The cloud forest is thick with mist and wild kith. Without a guide, Rhea would never find her way out.
why.fens: The fens are flooded. The causeways are under water.
why.deep-desert: Nobody walks into the deep desert without water and a guide.
why.storm-roost: Lightning walks the slopes of the Storm Roost. Not today.
why.low-water: The canal stair is locked and chained.
why.osk: The shoals are under deep water. The tide won't drop for a long time yet.
why.salt-house: The salt marshes are a maze of sucking mud. Rhea would need someone who knows the way.
why.wandering-herd: The eastern plateau is bare and endless. Rhea has no reason to go there yet.
why.cloudline: The terrace clans don't want strangers on their slopes. Rhea keeps to the road.
why.millbridge: Farmland and fences. Rhea has no business off the road here yet.
why.millcities: The mill roads are full of Guild clerks checking papers. Better to keep to the road.
why.old-drove-road: The drovers' grazing. Nothing out there for Rhea yet.
why.kerrow-gorge: The gorge drops away into mist. There's no path down that Rhea knows.
why.vael: The spire paths belong to the Spire Folk. Nobody climbs them without being asked.
